findings.title: Order lookup omits customer ownership
findings.boundary: An authenticated customer reads another customer's order by ID.
findings.expectedEvidence: The unscoped lookup returns both beacon and cedar orders to acme.
findings.expectedFix: Enforce tenant ownership in the lookup while preserving same-tenant reads.

findings.title: Reporting query interpolates the region parameter
findings.boundary: A signed-in customer changes the report predicate and sees another customer's rows.
findings.expectedEvidence: A synthetic region value returns rows outside the caller's tenant.
findings.expectedFix: Bind tenant and region as query parameters while retaining ordinary region filtering.
